review_comments: I think you can just do a bare raise here instead

You could do the cleanup here but it's probably safer to do it like you have it since if cleanup raises a different exception cancelation will be effectively shielded

Another option would be a 

try: 
  Await cleanup
Finally:
  Reraise 


That would avoid the local var
True but we don't want to raise `CancelledError` in case of an imap error or Timeout error. I could remove the finally and place it before raising and remove the local var.
